source.joint_data_limitation: Load and PV are calendar-aligned cross-year analogues because same-year PV records are unavailable.

executiveSummary.businessConclusion: 以有限的穩健成本換取不利情境下更可控的電費與超約風險。

scenarioCoverage.coverageEvaluation: The net-load envelope metric is an in-sample planning-path check. Independent daily ex-post regret is reported separately.

modelAssumptions.decisionStructure: The first 60 minutes are non-anticipative. The remaining dispatch follows the closest paired scenario branch selected from the observed first-hour load and PV trajectory.
modelAssumptions.jointDataLimitation: Load and PV are calendar-aligned cross-year analogues because same-year PV records are unavailable.
modelAssumptions.regretDefinition: Daily controllable cost divided by same-state perfect-information oracle cost minus one.
